name: gradient-wide-matrix
title: Wide Matrix
description: A decorative vertical gradient block with many stops: pale pink and peach at the bottom, through coral, rose and violet, ending in deep navy blue at the top.
use: A rich sunset-to-night field is needed behind a headline, card or media block.
avoid: Its many fixed stops shift quickly, so mid-tones can make overlaid text hard to read.
a11y: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it conveys no information on its own. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle filled by a tall vertical gradient: pale pink and peach along the bottom edge, warming through coral and rose, then violet, finishing in a deep navy blue at the top. Black margins frame it.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The seven colour stops are fixed, though classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
customise: The seven gradient stops sit in the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight: light: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.
